column1: # The app catalog: one row per app, tab-separated. install.sh reads it to build
# the app menu, the Glance dashboard and the URL summary; nothing else does.
#   genre      folder under containers/ (core is always installed)
#   app        folder under the genre, and the name used with --apps
#   subdomain  the app answers at http://<subdomain>.<DOMAIN>; - for none
#   port       host port the app publishes, i.e. http://<tailscale-ip>:<port>
#   icon       Glance icon (di: = dashboard-icons); - for none
#   about      one line for the menu
